name: manual_274879
claim: Infer LAN topology from the interface prefix length, not an assumed /24: hosts with different third octets can share one /22. Diagnose an unreachable peer by port reachability and policy (portal down, token-over-HTTP refusal by design) before blaming the subnet.

decisions.notes: 2026-10-23: a report wrongly said the Windows node and the Mac were on different subnets; both interfaces used a /22 and the real causes were a stopped portal and the deliberate SECURITY_STOP refusal.

rationale: 2026-10-23: a report wrongly said the Windows node and the Mac were on different subnets; both interfaces used a /22 and the real causes were a stopped portal and the deliberate SECURITY_STOP refusal.
